title: Software Engineer, macOS Core Product - Salvador, Brazil
description:
About Speechify

At Speechify, our mission is to ensure reading is never a barrier to learning . Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products—including apps on iOS, Android, macOS, Chrome, and web—to listen to PDFs, books, docs, and web content faster, smarter, and more joyfully than ever before. Our product has earned recognition from Google (Chrome Extension of the Year) and Apple (App of the Day and 2025 Inclusivity Design Award ) for its impact and accessibility.

We’re a fully remote, distributed team of engineers, designers, researchers, and product builders from world‑class companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Stripe, and more. We move fast, ship often, and love solving real user problems.

Role Overview

As a Software Engineer on the macOS team , you’ll help build and scale Speechify’s core desktop experience for millions of users. You’ll own significant parts of our macOS app architecture, ship production‑ready code, and collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams across the company.

This is a key role for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced startup environment, enjoys making high‑impact product decisions, loves delightful user experiences, and has a passion for accessibility and performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead key engineering and product decisions for the macOS app.
  • Write, test, and ship production‑quality code that scales to millions of users.
  • Maintain and evolve complex app architecture with a focus on performance and stability.
  • Work within a cross‑functional team, partnering with designers and PMs to shape features from concept to launch.
  • Participate in product planning and roadmap discussions.
  • Drive continuous improvement in code quality, CI/CD processes, and development workflows.

You should have:

  • Demonstrated experience shipping macOS (or related desktop) applications used by many customers.
  • Strong engineering instincts with a deep focus on user experience.
  • A strategic mindset for building great products—not just writing code.
  • Ability to work quickly, decide what to build now vs. later, and iterate fast.
  • Experience working in remote, distributed teams.

Technical requirements:

  • Swift / SwiftUI (macOS) proficiency.
  • Solid understanding of AppKit , macOS frameworks, and desktop‑specific UI paradigms.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency and asynchronous execution models.
  • Familiarity with Bitrise, CI/CD workflows (e.g., Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong understanding of concurrency and asynchronous execution models.

What We offer:

  • Impact & Ownership: Build and influence a product used by millions globally.
  • Remote First: Flexible, asynchronous work culture.
  • Growth & Leadership: Flat org — leadership is earned by impact, not title.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work with smart, passionate engineers and designers.
  • Competitive Compensation: Market‑aligned salary, bonus, and equity.

Why Join Speechify?

At Speechify, we ship fast, build for real users, and care deeply about quality and accessibility. You’ll work on products that change lives, and your contributions will shape both the product and the company.

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your resume and links to your portfolio or GitHub!

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas :

About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US‑based software company delivering high‑impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission‑driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development – building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large‑scale, high‑performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF), custom post types, and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third‑party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make / Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs, background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React‑based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well‑documented, and unit‑tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience, focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters), custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF, CPT UI, Gutenberg, and WooCommerce.
  • Solid understanding of the WordPress REST API, webhooks, and API integrations.
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with performance optimization, caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English required for international client communication.

Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to work on the project that manages all the institutional pages of a client's domain in the insurance sector, as well as lead capture forms and product acquisition flows (Insurance, Banking, Services).

This professional will work on the end‑to‑end development and maintenance of AEM solutions—components, templates, integrations, and support for the Java BFF layer—within a modern architecture that integrates AEM, Next.js, Adobe Commerce, and an AWS Serverless middleware (Carbon).

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, models, templates, and pages.
  • Implement and maintain the Java BFF layer running on serverless architecture.
  • Create and maintain custom administrative dashboards within AEM CMS.
  • Integrate AEM with multiple corporate APIs, ensuring security, performance, and stability.
  • Collaborate with React / Next.js teams for visual and structural integration (preferred).
  • Work closely with architecture, backend, and middleware teams to ensure technical consistency.
  • Analyze technical impacts and propose improvements for scalability, performance, resilience, and user experience.
  • Provide technical support for Adobe Commerce, Carbon middleware, and AWS serverless integrations.

Technical Requirements

  • Senior‑level experience with Adobe Experience Manager 6.x+ :
  • Component, model, template, and page development
  • Sling Models & OSGi
  • HTL templating
  • AEM Sites / AEM Author
  • Strong expertise in Java , ideally with serverless architecture.
  • Experience with REST API integrations, authentication, security, and data handling.

  • Ability to work within complex architectures (AEM + Middleware + APIs + Front‑end).

Preferred Technical Competencies

  • Knowledge of React and collaboration with frontend teams.
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR / SSG).

  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Strong analytical capability and autonomy in technical decision‑making.
  • Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Systemic thinking to operate across integrated architectures (AEM + BFF + Middleware + Commerce).
  • Proactivity in problem-solving and risk identification.
  • Organization and discipline in documentation and execution.

Skill Set Summary

  • AEM 6.x+ (components, Sling, OSGi, Sites, dispatcher basics)
  • Java (serverless, REST APIs, architectural patterns)
  • AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, serverless services)
  • Git / GitFlow
  • Corporate API integrations
  • Basic understanding of React / Next.js
  • Knowledge of security, monitoring, logging, and performance best practices

title: Cro, Ux Product Specialist (Onboarding, Content) | Remote, Part-Time 20-30 Hrs
description:
About FullSession

FullSession is a user behavior analytics platform that helps teams understand how people really use their product or website, remove UX friction, and prove the impact of changes on activation, conversion, and revenue. Our customers span SaaS , Ecommerce/DTC , and Enterprise customer portals (finance, insurance, travel, etc.).

We’re building toward a world where teams go from seeing what happened → knowing what to fix next → validating lift .

The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid Product + CRO/UX Specialist who can wear three hats:

  • Customer onboarding & demo specialist: help prospects/customers get to “first value” fast (this is not a sales role)
  • CRO expert : diagnose funnel friction, propose experiments, and validate impact
  • Content contributor : turn real work into practical writing (CRO/UX playbooks, teardown-style posts, case studies)

This is a hands‑on role. You’ll be in the product, in real customer journeys, and in front of customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Audit key journeys (signup → activation, onboarding, checkout, forms, critical flows) using session replay, heatmaps, funnels, and feedback.
  • Identify friction, quantify opportunity size, and prioritize a clear backlog of improvements.
  • Propose experiments and UX changes with strong hypotheses, expected impact, and success metrics.
  • Partner with product/engineering to specify changes (flow, copy, layout, instrumentation) and ensure tracking is correct.
  • Help validate lift (conversion, activation, completion, revenue per visitor, drop‑off reduction) and document learnings.
  • Run onboarding calls and product walkthroughs; help teams install/implement and reach “first insights” quickly.
  • Translate customer goals into a simple measurement plan (events/funnels) and a short list of “what to fix first.”
  • Collect structured feedback from calls and turn it into actionable product recommendations.

Writing & Thought Leadership (CRO/UX)

  • Co‑create short, high‑signal content with us: blog posts, case studies, teardown‑style insights, and playbooks.
  • Share best practices for CRO, UX, and experimentation across SaaS, Ecommerce, and high‑stakes portals.
  • Optionally publish under your name (with transparency/disclosure where relevant).

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Customers reach “first value” faster (clearer onboarding, faster first insights, fewer setup blockers).
  • A repeatable onboarding playbook (talk tracks, checklists, templates).
  • A prioritized list of product + UX improvements informed by real data and real calls.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in CRO/UX optimization and/or Product Management for a live website/web app (B2B SaaS and/or Ecommerce).
  • Strong experimentation skills: hypothesis design, metrics, A/B testing fundamentals, interpreting results.
  • Strong analytics + behavior tooling experience (GA4 and a replay/heatmap/funnel tool such as FullSession, Hotjar, etc.).
  • Comfortable moving between quantitative and qualitative signals (funnels/events + replays/feedback).
  • Strong written English: you can explain what you found, what you changed, and why it mattered.
  • High ownership: you work independently, communicate clearly async, and ship work without heavy supervision.

Nice to have

  • Experience with onboarding/implementation for analytics tools (tagging, events, confirmation that data is flowing).
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations (masking, PII, consent, compliance).
  • Experience writing for Product/Growth audiences (LinkedIn, Medium, blog).

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote‑friendly engagement (start part‑time 20+ hours; option to expand).
  • Fair compensation at $23/hr -- FT equivalent (173.3 hrs) = $3,986
  • Work on meaningful CRO/UX problems with modern behavior analytics tooling.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and real customer journeys.
  • Opportunities to build your public portfolio via co‑authored content.

description:
CRO, UX Product Specialist (Onboarding, Content) | Remote, Part-time 20-30 hrs FullSession•feira de santana, estado da bahia, br

Descrição da vaga

About FullSession

FullSession is a user behavior analytics platform that helps teams understand how people really use their product or website, remove UX friction, and prove the impact of changes on activation, conversion, and revenue. Our customers span SaaS , Ecommerce/DTC , and Enterprise customer portals (finance, insurance, travel, etc.).

We’re building toward a world where teams go from seeing what happened → knowing what to fix next → validating lift.

The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid Product + CRO/UX Specialist who can wear three hats:

  • Customer onboarding & demo specialist: help prospects/customers get to “first value” fast (this is not a sales role)
  • CRO expert : diagnose funnel friction, propose experiments, and validate impact
  • Content contributor : turn real work into practical writing (CRO/UX playbooks, teardown-style posts, case studies)

This is a hands‑on role. You’ll be in the product, in real customer journeys, and in front of customers.

What You’ll Do

CRO / UX & Experimentation:

  • Audit key journeys (signup → activation, onboarding, checkout, forms, critical flows) using session replay, heatmaps, funnels, and feedback.
  • Identify friction, quantify opportunity size, and prioritize a clear backlog of improvements.
  • Propose experiments and UX changes with strong hypotheses, expected impact, and success metrics.
  • Partner with product/engineering to specify changes (flow, copy, layout, instrumentation) and ensure tracking is correct.
  • Help validate lift (conversion, activation, completion, revenue per visitor, drop‑off reduction) and document learnings.

Customer Onboarding & Demos (CS, not sales):

  • Run onboarding calls and product walkthroughs; help teams install/implement and reach “first insights” quickly.
  • Translate customer goals into a simple measurement plan (events/funnels) and a short list of “what to fix first.”
  • Collect structured feedback from calls and turn it into actionable product recommendations.

Writing & Thought Leadership (CRO/UX)

  • Co‑create short, high‑signal content with us: blog posts, case studies, teardown‑style insights, and playbooks.
  • Share best practices for CRO, UX, and experimentation across SaaS, Ecommerce, and high‑stakes portals.
  • Optionally publish under your name (with transparency/disclosure where relevant).

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Customers reach “first value” faster (clearer onboarding, faster first insights, fewer setup blockers).
  • A repeatable onboarding playbook (talk tracks, checklists, templates).
  • A prioritized list of product + UX improvements informed by real data and real calls.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in CRO/UX optimization and/or Product Management for a live website/web app (B2B SaaS and/or Ecommerce).
  • Strong experimentation skills: hypothesis design, metrics, A/B testing fundamentals, interpreting results.
  • Strong analytics + behavior tooling experience (GA4 and a replay/heatmap/funnel tool such as FullSession, Hotjar, etc.).
  • Comfortable moving between quantitative and qualitative signals (funnels/events + replays/feedback).
  • Strong written English: you can explain what you found, what you changed, and why it mattered.
  • High ownership: you work independently, communicate clearly async, and ship work without heavy supervision.

Nice to have

  • Experience with onboarding/implementation for analytics tools (tagging, events, confirmation that data is flowing).
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations (masking, PII, consent, compliance).
  • Experience writing for Product/Growth audiences (LinkedIn, Medium, blog).

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote‑friendly engagement (start part‑time 20+ hours; option to expand).
  • Fair compensation at $23/hr -- FT equivalent (173.3 hrs) = $3,986
  • Work on meaningful CRO/UX problems with modern behavior analytics tooling.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and real customer journeys.
  • Opportunities to build your public portfolio via co‑authored content.

Descrição da vaga

LOCATION

Remote — Western Europe, Latin America (Argentina, Brasil/Brazil, Uruguay, Chile, Colombia)

About FullSession

FullSession is a user behavior analytics platform that helps teams understand how people really use their product or website, remove UX friction, and prove the impact of changes on activation, conversion, and revenue. Our customers span SaaS , Ecommerce/DTC , and Enterprise customer portals (finance, insurance, travel, etc.).

We’re building toward a world where teams go from seeing what happened → knowing what to fix next → validating lift .

The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid Product + CRO/UX Specialist who can wear three hats:

  • Customer onboarding & demo specialist: help prospects/customers get to “first value” fast (this is not a sales role)
  • CRO expert : diagnose funnel friction, propose experiments, and validate impact
  • Content contributor : turn real work into practical writing (CRO/UX playbooks, teardown-style posts, case studies)

This is a hands‑on role. You’ll be in the product, in real customer journeys, and in front of customers.

What You’ll Do

CRO / UX & Experimentation:

  • Audit key journeys (signup → activation, onboarding, checkout, forms, critical flows) using session replay, heatmaps, funnels, and feedback.
  • Identify friction, quantify opportunity size, and prioritize a clear backlog of improvements.
  • Propose experiments and UX changes with strong hypotheses, expected impact, and success metrics.
  • Partner with product/engineering to specify changes (flow, copy, layout, instrumentation) and ensure tracking is correct.
  • Help validate lift (conversion, activation, completion, revenue per visitor, drop-off reduction) and document learnings.

Customer Onboarding & Demos (CS, not sales):

  • Run onboarding calls and product walkthroughs; help teams install/implement and reach “first insights” quickly.
  • Translate customer goals into a simple measurement plan (events/funnels) and a short list of “what to fix first.”
  • Collect structured feedback from calls and turn it into actionable product recommendations.

Writing & Thought Leadership (CRO/UX)

  • Co-create short, high-signal content with us: blog posts, case studies, teardown-style insights, and playbooks.
  • Share best practices for CRO, UX, and experimentation across SaaS, Ecommerce, and high-stakes portals.
  • Optionally publish under your name (with transparency/disclosure where relevant).

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Customers reach “first value” faster (clearer onboarding, faster first insights, fewer setup blockers).
  • A repeatable onboarding playbook (talk tracks, checklists, templates).
  • A prioritized list of product + UX improvements informed by real data and real calls.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in CRO/UX optimization and/or Product Management for a live website/web app (B2B SaaS and/or Ecommerce).
  • Strong experimentation skills: hypothesis design, metrics, A/B testing fundamentals, interpreting results.
  • Strong analytics + behavior tooling experience (GA4 and a replay/heatmap/funnel tool such as FullSession, Hotjar, etc.).
  • Comfortable moving between quantitative and qualitative signals (funnels/events + replays/feedback).
  • Strong written English: you can explain what you found, what you changed, and why it mattered.
  • High ownership: you work independently, communicate clearly async, and ship work without heavy supervision.

Nice to have

  • Experience with onboarding/implementation for analytics tools (tagging, events, confirmation that data is flowing).
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations (masking, PII, consent, compliance).
  • Experience writing for Product/Growth audiences (LinkedIn, Medium, blog).

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote-friendly engagement (start part-time 20+ hours; option to expand).
  • Fair compensation at $23/hr -- FT equivalent (173.3 hrs) = $3,986
  • Work on meaningful CRO/UX problems with modern behavior analytics tooling.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and real customer journeys.
  • Opportunities to build your public portfolio via co-authored content.

Descrição da vaga

To Apply

Please complete this form:

LOCATION

Remote — Western Europe, Latin America (Argentina, Brasil/Brazil, Uruguay, Chile, Colombia)

About FullSession

FullSession is a user behavior analytics platform that helps teams understand how people really use their product or website, remove UX friction, and prove the impact of changes on activation, conversion, and revenue. Our customers span SaaS , Ecommerce/DTC , and Enterprise customer portals (finance, insurance, travel, etc.).

We’re building toward a world where teams go from seeing what happened → knowing what to fix next → validating lift.

The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid Product + CRO/UX Specialist who can wear three hats:

  • Customer onboarding & demo specialist: help prospects/customers get to “first value” fast (this is not a sales role)
  • CRO expert : diagnose funnel friction, propose experiments, and validate impact
  • Content contributor : turn real work into practical writing (CRO/UX playbooks, teardown-style posts, case studies)

This is a hands‑on role. You’ll be in the product, in real customer journeys, and in front of customers.

What You’ll Do

CRO / UX & Experimentation

  • Audit key journeys (signup → activation, onboarding, checkout, forms, critical flows) using session replay, heatmaps, funnels, and feedback.
  • Identify friction, quantify opportunity size, and prioritize a clear backlog of improvements.
  • Propose experiments and UX changes with strong hypotheses, expected impact, and success metrics.
  • Partner with product/engineering to specify changes (flow, copy, layout, instrumentation) and ensure tracking is correct.
  • Help validate lift (conversion, activation, completion, revenue per visitor, drop‑off reduction) and document learnings.

Customer Onboarding & Demos (CS, not sales)

  • Run onboarding calls and product walkthroughs; help teams install/implement and reach “first insights” quickly.
  • Translate customer goals into a simple measurement plan (events/funnels) and a short list of “what to fix first.”
  • Collect structured feedback from calls and turn it into actionable product recommendations.

Writing & Thought Leadership (CRO/UX)

  • Co‑create short, high‑signal content with us: blog posts, case studies, teardown‑style insights, and playbooks.
  • Share best practices for CRO, UX, and experimentation across SaaS, Ecommerce, and high‑stakes portals.
  • Optionally publish under your name (with transparency/disclosure where relevant).

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Customers reach “first value” faster (clearer onboarding, faster first insights, fewer setup blockers).
  • A repeatable onboarding playbook (talk tracks, checklists, templates).
  • A prioritized list of product + UX improvements informed by real data and real calls.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in CRO/UX optimization and/or Product Management for a live website/web app (B2B SaaS and/or Ecommerce).
  • Strong experimentation skills: hypothesis design, metrics, A/B testing fundamentals, interpreting results.
  • Strong analytics + behaviour tooling experience (GA4 and a replay/heatmap/funnel tool such as FullSession, Hotjar, etc.).
  • Comfortable moving between quantitative and qualitative signals (funnels/events + replays/feedback).
  • Strong written English: you can explain what you found, what you changed, and why it mattered.
  • High ownership: you work independently, communicate clearly async, and ship work without heavy supervision.

Nice to have

  • Experience with onboarding/implementation for analytics tools (tagging, events, confirmation that data is flowing).
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations (masking, PII, consent, compliance).
  • Experience writing for Product/Growth audiences (LinkedIn, Medium, blog).

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote‑friendly engagement (start part‑time 20+ hours; option to expand).
  • Fair compensation at $23/hr – FT equivalent (173.3 hrs) = $3,986.
  • Work on meaningful CRO/UX problems with modern behaviour analytics tooling.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and real customer journeys.
  • Opportunities to build your public portfolio via co‑authored content.

About the Team/Role

As WEX continues to scale its Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) platform, the Data Acquisition Team plays a critical role in enabling secure, scalable, and reliable ingestion of data from hundreds of internal systems and external sources.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to architect and lead the next evolution of our data acquisition platform. In this role, you will drive the design of a flexible, extensible ingestion framework that supports batch, streaming, and event-driven pipelines, while ensuring data quality, observability, and governance are built in from the start.

This role is ideal for engineers who want to work on foundational platform problems at scale—helping ingest billions of records across diverse systems and powering enterprise-wide analytics, AI, and product experiences.

How you'll make an impact

  • Lead the design and development of scalable, high-throughput data acquisition systems that integrate internal and external data sources across domains.

  • Architect core platform components—such as data routing, transformation orchestration, lineage tracking, and schema evolution—using sound software engineering principles.

  • Implement a modular ingestion framework capable of supporting streaming and batch pipelines with varying latencies and SLAs.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and establish best practices in code quality, performance optimization, testing, and platform observability.

  • Collaborate with domain teams to understand data integration needs and accelerate onboarding through reusable patterns and automation.

  • Partner closely with the Control Plane and DataOps teams to integrate orchestration, lineage, access control, and validation into the core ingestion process.

  • Build and maintain high-performance data acquisition pipelines that integrate with a variety of systems across WEX and third-party vendors.

  • Contribute to the development of a modular ingestion platform that enables reusability, reliability, and observability at scale.

  • Implement core pipeline components such as schema validation, transformation orchestration, error handling, and audit logging.

  • Support batch and streaming ingestion flows, ensuring the platform meets varying latency and volume requirements across business units.

  • Ensure traceability, lineage, and security through integration with control plane and governance systems.

  • Participate in code reviews, design sessions, and incident resolution—promoting high standards for code quality and operational reliability.

Experience you'll bring

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; M.Sc. a plus but not required.

  • Strong years of experience as a software or data engineer, ideally in high-volume or distributed systems environments.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, or another systems-focused language.

  • Experience with data integration and ingestion pipelines—you understand what it means to bring data in from source systems, transform it, and deliver it reliably downstream.

  • Solid grasp of engineering fundamentals, including version control, modular design, testing, and performance tuning.

  • Familiarity with concepts like schema evolution, event-driven architectures, observability, and role-based access control.

  • A collaborative mindset—comfortable working across domains, products, and infrastructure layers.

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability—you care deeply about building systems that last.

description:
At Wellhub (Permanent), in Portugal

Salary : €55.000 - €68.000

Expires at :

Remote policy : Full remote

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

  • Big news : Gympass is now Wellhub!

We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist in our Generative AI area in Portugal ! This is a Remote – Portugal position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

YOUR IMPACT

Multimodal Extraction : Apply state-of-the-art tools (OCR, vision-language models, document understanding frameworks) to interpret diverse input types;

Prompt Engineering : Develop and refine strategies for using LLMs to extract, summarize, and transform unstructured content into structured formats;

Data Quality & Structuring : Clean, validate, and transform messy, unstructured data into well-defined schemas ready for use in training or analytics pipelines;

Content Filtering : Define standards and build systems for cleaning, validating, and filtering data to ensure accuracy, reduce bias, and align with ethical / safety guidelines;

Human-in-the-Loop Feedback : Design feedback loops where experts validate or enrich data, improving LLM-based extraction reliability;

Scalability & Optimization : Architect cost-efficient, high-throughput data pipelines that are robust to noisy or incomplete sources;

Research & Prototyping : Experiment with emerging tools and methods in the LLM + multimodal space, exploring new ways to enhance information coverage and extraction reliability;

Collaboration : Partner with data engineers and other data scientists to integrate collected data into larger AI and analytics systems;

Live the mission : inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Main requirements

WHO YOU ARE

  • Master’s degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field;
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries for web scraping, OCR (e.g., Tesseract, EasyOCR), and NLP (e.g., HuggingFace Transformers);
  • Deep understanding of LLM capabilities in multimodal and extraction contexts, including prompt engineering and few-shot learning;
  • Strong background in unstructured data processing : APIs, web scraping, HTML parsing, OCR, image / document analysis;
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with a track record of turning noisy data into high-quality datasets for ML;
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence across technical and product teams.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in data science and Python are mandatory requirements.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with visual-language models (e.g., BLIP, Donut, or LayoutLM) and multimodal pipelines;
  • Hands-on experience in prompt engineering and few-shot learning for data extraction tasks;
  • Experience deploying or supporting data acquisition systems in production environments.

Benefits & Perks

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our benefits include :

  • WELLHUB : We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • FITNESS : Additional fitness subsidy to access onsite gyms and fitness studios.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK : At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options : flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE : We understand that together, Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their own individual scopes. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF : We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).
  • PARENTAL LEAVE : Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH : Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE : An exciting and supportive environment filled with passionate individuals from all over the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Co-Liderança de Pesquisa em Saúde Digital – Projeto REDS Bahia
description:
Estamos convidando pessoas com sólida experiência em pesquisa, estratégia ou desenvolvimento de intervenções digitais e gestão de projetos para dedicação em tempo integral, focada no desenvolvimento de avaliação sobre o impacto da Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS) na prontidão dos serviços, acesso, qualidade e eficiência. A contratação poderá servir para fins de pós-doutoramento, caso a pessoa selecionada seja tenha o grau de Doutorado.

O(a) candidato(a) estará sediado(a) e irá compor uma equipe de pesquisa sobre serviços de saúde com sede no Centro de Integração de Dados e Conhecimentos para Saúde (CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA), Salvador, Bahia, Brasil. O projeto é financiado pela Gates Foundation. Encorajamos fortemente candidaturas de pesquisadores negro(a)s, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos menos representados.

Sobre a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS)

Em 2021, foi criada a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS), cujo propósito é integrar e unificar os dados de pacientes provenientes da rede estadual de saúde em um único repositório centralizado. A REDS tem como foco a consolidação de prontuários eletrônicos, possibilitando, entre outros benefícios, a mensuração do cuidado e dos custos em nível individual do paciente, por meio de uma plataforma segura e atualizada em tempo real.

Considerando a ampla adoção do prontuário eletrônico na atenção primária, a REDS está em processo de expansão, impulsionada pela implementação do mesmo sistema de prontuário eletrônico utilizado em hospitais estaduais (o AGHUse). Essa padronização é considerada estratégica e essencial para permitir a integração de dados com fins de coordenação do cuidado entre os diferentes níveis da rede de atenção à saúde.

A principal funcionalidade da REDS é viabilizar o acesso ao prontuário do paciente entre diferentes pontos da rede, consolidando dados de imunização, exames laboratoriais e registros clínicos, além de subsidiar análises de gestão orientadas à vigilância em saúde, ao monitoramento de políticas públicas e à tomada de decisão.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Articular a temática de redes interoperáveis, avaliação de impacto em serviços de saúde e análise de implementação de políticas e intervenções digitais na saúde entre os distintos grupos do projeto REDS
  • Auxiliar na gestão de equipe de pesquisadores de avaliação de impacto e epidemiologia
  • Produzir e aplicar um modelo metodológico de documentação e avaliação da REDS e sua integração com sistemas existentes, baseado em revisão de marcos conceituais sobre redes de interoperabilidade de dados em saúde e na sua proposta de valor para acesso e qualidade de serviços de saúde
  • Gerir a coleta, organização e análise dos dados de pesquisa qualitativa junto a participantes e demais pesquisadores
  • Documentar, sistematizar e apresentar aprendizados, ferramentas e recomendações para institucionalização dos achados do projeto.
  • Conduzir o planejamento e gerenciar o fluxo de entregas da pesquisa junto ao financiador internacional
  • Conduzir e apresentar resultados em reuniões de acompanhamento do projeto de pesquisa
  • Conduzir reuniões de engajamento de parceiros externos da pesquisa
  • Produzir, escrever e revisar artigos científicos e relatórios do projeto
  • Participar de eventos científicos, realizar apresentações e conduzir formações e oficinas

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Doutorado concluído ou em andamento* em Saúde Coletiva ou Saúde Pública, Epidemiologia, Ciências da Saúde, Gestão Pública, Economia, Ciências Sociais, Informática em Saúde, Ciências da Computação, ou áreas correlatas
  • Familiaridade e interesse em temas como inovação digital, informática e tecnologia para saúde, epidemiologia, avaliação de impacto, econometria, ciência de dados em saúde, e gestão de serviços de saúde
  • Boa comunicação escrita e oral em inglês
  • Participação em atividades de gestão de projetos, preferencialmente de pesquisa, de desenvolvimento tecnológico, ou de inovação social
  • Conhecimento sobre fundamentos teóricos de avaliação de impacto e ciências da implementação
  • Disponibilidade para início imediato
  • O requisito de formação de doutorado poderá ser substituído por mestrado e ao menos dois anos de experiência comprovada na temática, conforme requisitos desejáveis listados abaixo

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Competência demonstrada em liderança de projetos, em particular de pesquisa (2 anos)*
  • Participação em projetos de saúde digital, em particular de pesquisa
  • Formação em terminologias de saúde e padrões de interoperabilidade (HL7 FHIR e openEHR)
  • Publicações em andamento ou finalizadas na área de avaliação de impacto
  • Experiência com projetos financiados por organização internacional
  • Experiência em gestão de equipe
  • Experiência em facilitação de dinâmicas
  • Destreza em uso de softwares de criação de apresentações e resumos gráficos
  • Familiaridade com softwares de análise de dados qualitativos (NVivo, Atlas.ti, outros)

Atitude esperada

  • Capacidade de motivar e engajar a equipe, parceiros
  • Autonomia analítica e desenvoltura para aprender novos métodos e instruir análises, refinando os resultados
  • Postura protagonista e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas próprias e co‑responsabilidade sobre as da equipe, com disposição para aprimorá‑las
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Desenvoltura para tomar decisões visando antecipar riscos ao projeto
  • Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Capacidade de delegar e adaptar funções e entregas
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em equipe
  • A ausência destes requisitos não impede o envio da candidatura mas será fator de desempate entre os participantes da seleção

Informações adicionais

A pessoa selecionada receberá bolsa com valor compatível do mercado, negociável a depender da experiência, por dedicação integral em um período de 12 (doze) meses, com possibilidade de renovação extensível por mais 6 (seis) meses. Também será considerada para envolvimento em outros projetos do CIDACS, mediante entrega de bons resultados e disponibilidade de financiamento. Enfatiza-se que a pessoa selecionada é sujeita a um período de 3 (três) meses iniciais de adaptação e avaliação.

Compromissos da Concessão de Bolsa no CIDACS

  • Os compromissos serão estabelecidos através de Plano de Trabalho e Cronograma de atividades estabelecidos pela pesquisa
  • Dedicar‑se integralmente ao projeto de pesquisa
  • Consultar o Coordenador do projeto no CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA e parceiros antes de aceitar qualquer apoio financeiro de qualquer outra fonte de financiamento, pública ou privada, para o desenvolvimento de projeto de pesquisa de temática similar
  • Não fazer modificações no projeto (plano inicial, datas etc.) sem prévio consentimento da equipe
  • Apresentar relatórios científicos e relatórios de aplicação dos recursos dentro dos prazos previstos no Plano de Trabalho acompanhados da documentação solicitada
  • Não se afastar da instituição em que desenvolve o projeto de pesquisa sem antes obter autorização explícita do Coordenador do projeto no CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA e parceiros mediante solicitação justificada apresentada pelo Orientador/Supervisor
  • Participar de curso de interesse do projeto de pesquisa que fundamenta a bolsa, por duração inferior a um mês
  • Participar de Reuniões Científicas ou Tecnológicas com ou sem apresentação de trabalhos
  • Fazer referência ao CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA nos produtos (artigos, livros, resumos de trabalhos apresentados em reuniões e qualquer outra publicação ou forma de divulgação) que resultem, total ou parcialmente, da bolsa concedida pelo CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA.
  • Indicar, também, o apoio de fontes de financiamento público ou privado que possam existir
  • Caso o desenvolvimento do projeto de pesquisa a que concerne a bolsa concedida tenha recebido apoio financeiro de qualquer outra fonte de financiamento, pública ou privada, o pesquisador se obriga a informar e fazer referência expressa a esse apoio, com a identificação clara de sua fonte, em todas as formas de divulgação mencionadas no item anterior
  • Zelar pela adequada proteção dos direitos de propriedade intelectual que possam resultar do projeto apoiado pelo CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA e demais parceiros deste projeto

  • Fornecer informações referentes ao processo produtivo a clientes internos, auxiliando na melhoria contínua da produção;
  • Fazer análise de sistema FIFO, com o foco em garantir que todos estão utilizando corretamente o sistema de cadastro dos materiais nas vagas, no sistema Dash Board;

O que oferecemos como companhia

Na Bridgestone, o que realmente importa é gerar oportunidades de cocriação, ao mesmo tempo que estimulamos a sua curiosidade e criatividade para tornar a mobilidade mais segura, mais eficiente e mais sustentável para as gerações presentes e futuras. Qualquer que seja a função que você desempenhe, quando você representar a Bridgestone, você é um(a) integrante valioso(a) e parte de nossa missão maior de “Servir a Sociedade com Qualidade Superior”. Oferecemos mais do que apenas pagamentos competitivos; nós lhe forneceremos:

  • Uma experiência de integração envolvente e de apoio para garantir uma transição tranquila para nossa equipe;
  • A oportunidade de desenvolver e crescer, através de formação e orientação regular;
  • Atividades de Responsabilidade Social Corporativa;
  • Um ambiente de trabalho verdadeiramente global, dinâmico e desafiador;
  • Agilidade e eficácia no trabalho/vida e no seu bem-estar a longo prazo;
  • Uma equipe diversificada e inclusiva.

A Bridgestone orgulha-se de ser um empregador com oportunidades iguais de emprego. É nossa política considerar todas as pessoas, independentemente de idade, cor, origem, deficiência física ou mental, raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade e/ou expressão de gênero, informação genética ou qualquer outra característica protegida por leis federais, estaduais ou locais.

Sobre nós

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), com sede em Nashville, Tennessee, e a Bridgestone Europa, Oriente Médio e África (BSEMEA), com sede em Bruxelas, Bélgica, operam coletivamente como uma região estratégica “Bridgestone West”. Esta região atende às necessidades estratégicas de negócios de equipes nas Américas, Europa, Oriente Médio e África. BSAM e BSEMEA são subsidiárias da Bridgestone Corporation, com sede global no Japão. A Bridgestone e suas subsidiárias desenvolvem, fabricam e comercializam uma ampla gama de produtos e soluções Bridgestone, Firestone e marcas associadas para atender às necessidades de uma ampla gama de clientes e indústrias.

Na Bridgestone, você é sempre livre para ser. Acreditamos que as pessoas só podem fornecer serviços e uma qualidade superior aos outros quando conseguem trazer o seu eu mais autêntico para o trabalho. Acreditamos na defesa de todas as perspectivas, indivíduos e equipes, porque entendemos a importância de ver o mundo e o nosso negócio através de diferentes perspectivas. Estamos construindo uma equipe tão diversa quanto o mundo que servimos. Então, mostre-nos do que você é feito; quem você é é o que precisamos.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You'll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won't be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You'll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.

Qualifications

Advanced English. You'll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.

You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil / LATAM, preferably to US companies.

Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.

Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.

Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.

  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.

Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?

Interview Steps

  1. Interview with a recruiter at LGH
  2. Panel interview with LGH leadership
  3. Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)
  4. Take a PAID practical assessment. This isn't a simulation. You'll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD / hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.
  5. Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you're in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Main responsibilities

  • Participar da “passagem de plantão” diariamente, no início e no final do expediente, recebendo, avaliando e repassando informações sobre a evolução clínica, intercorrências obstétricas, condições materno-fetais, partos realizados, puerpério e orientações que possam interferir no funcionamento do setor de Obstetrícia durante a jornada;
  • Visitar todas as gestantes, parturientes e puérperas, ao iniciar o expediente, após a passagem de plantão, sob os cuidados de sua equipe, com o objetivo de avaliar a evolução obstétrica, condições maternas e fetais, estado do puerpério, inspecionar as instalações e obter/prestar informações necessárias;
  • Avaliar diariamente a disponibilidade de medicamentos obstétricos, materiais e insumos específicos (parto, emergência obstétrica, assistência ao recém-nascido), instrumental e roupas, providenciando as reposições necessárias;
  • Supervisionar a solicitação de medicamentos e materiais obstétricos, assegurando que estejam de acordo com a prescrição médica e protocolos assistenciais;
  • Recepcionar e prestar os atendimentos iniciais de enfermagem às gestantes recém-internadas, parturientes ou puérperas, realizando acolhimento, anamnese de enfermagem, orientações sobre rotinas do setor e esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Elaborar o aprazamento das prescrições médicas e o plano de cuidados de enfermagem obstétrica, considerando as necessidades da gestante, parturiente, puérpera e recém-nascido, acompanhando a eficácia da assistência prestada;
  • Orientar e supervisionar a equipe de técnicos de enfermagem quanto à execução correta dos cuidados obstétricos, assistência ao trabalho de parto, parto, puerpério e cuidados imediatos ao recém-nascido, bem como o apoio à equipe médica;
  • Prestar assistência direta de enfermagem à gestante, parturiente e puérpera, bem como apoio aos médicos durante o trabalho de parto, parto, procedimentos diagnósticos e terapêuticos;
  • Realizar procedimentos técnicos especializados de enfermagem obstétrica, tais como administração de medicamentos, monitorização materno-fetal, cardiotocografia, sondagem vesical, punção venosa, cuidados no pós-parto e assistência imediata ao recém-nascido, conforme protocolos institucionais;

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.

What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.

Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.

Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?

Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.

– This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.

5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

Descrição da vaga

What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.

What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.

Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.

Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?

Interview Steps

  1. Interview with a recruiter at LGH
  2. Panel interview with LGH leadership
  3. Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)
  4. Take a PAID practical assessment. – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.
  5. Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

Job description

Sobre a vaga

NaM. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura

Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to augment the existing team and help accelerate delivery of a critical platform rewrite. The Senior Salesforce Developer will work alongside our partner teams, contributing hands-on to the design and development of the new integrated platform. This is a full-stack Salesforce role, with a strong emphasis on backend development, system integrations, and data modeling, as well as selective frontend work following established UI patterns and standards.

In this role, they will be expected to take ownership of complex features, contribute to technical decision-making, and uphold engineering best practices across a distributed development environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce backend components (Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, async processing) aligned with the ongoing platform rewrite.

Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions, including data modeling, integration patterns, and performance optimization.

Implement front-end functionality (LWC / Aura) by following existing design systems, UX patterns, and coding standards.

Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST / SOAP APIs and event-driven patterns where applicable.

Collaborate closely with distributed teams, including India-based Salesforce developers and the Brazil-based Astra team, ensuring alignment and consistent delivery.

Perform code reviews, mentor less-experienced developers, and promote best practices across the codebase.

Ensure solutions meet high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.

Participate in our partner’s technical vetting, documentation, and formal code review processes.

Proactively identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement during the rewrite effort.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with deep expertise in Apex, triggers, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns.

Strong understanding of Salesforce platform limits, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.

Experience building and maintaining Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working within established front-end frameworks.

Proven experience working on complex, large-scale Salesforce implementations or platform rewrites.

Exposure to cloud platforms and migration initiatives (GCP preferred, but AWS / Azure acceptable).

Experience working in distributed or staff-augmentation teams, collaborating across time zones and cultures.

Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.

Nearshore location preferred (Brazil, Mexico, Costa Rica) to ensure time-zone alignment.

Ability to successfully pass a full technical interview and live coding assessment.

Nice to Have

Exposure to Flutter or Go, which may be relevant for future product initiatives.

Experience with video / audio streaming applications or real-time collaboration platforms.

Familiarity with CI / CD pipelines, automated testing, and Salesforce DevOps tooling.

Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I / II, Integration Architecture Designer) are a plus.

Why Join

Work on a high-impact, end-to-end platform rewrite with a clearly defined launch timeline.

Collaborate with senior engineers and technical leaders in a distributed, cross-functional environment.

Opportunity to influence architecture and engineering practices on a mission-critical system.

Fully remote, nearshore-friendly role with potential for long-term engagement and growth.

Benefits

A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.

The opportunity to work on a high-impact, mission-critical platform alongside senior engineers in a fully remote, collaborative environment.

Two weeks of paid vacation per year.

10 paid days for local holidays.

  • Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Job Title: Wireless Domain Architect (Arista focused) Location: Brazil (Must be located in Brazil) Role: 90 Day Contract to Hire (Potential to convert from Contract to Full Time Employee with benefits)

Position Overview

The Wireless Domain Architect is a senior, hands‑on technical leadership role within a professional IT services organization, serving as the technical authority for enterprise wireless architecture.

This position demands expertise in Arista’s next‑generation wireless platforms, with demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and supporting Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV‑CUE) solutions. The role blends solution design, field deployment leadership, pre‑sales technical scoping, and escalation support, operating as both an architect and hands‑on technical mentor to delivery teams.

Core Responsibilities

  • Wireless Architecture & Design: Serve as the primary wireless domain expert, with deep, hands‑on experience in Arista Wireless architecture, hardware, and cloud‑managed technologies. Design enterprise‑grade wireless solutions leveraging Arista’s cognitive networking capabilities, including: CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV‑CUE) centralized management, orchestration, and AI/ML‑driven automation planes; Cognitive Wi‑Fi platforms that provide data‑driven telemetry, real‑time analytics, and automatic optimization of wireless connections as network conditions evolve; Multi‑radio, multifunction AP deployments with support for cutting‑edge standards such as Wi‑Fi 6E and Wi‑Fi 7, zero‑touch onboarding, and high‑density coverage models. Develop high‑level and low‑level wireless designs (HLDs/LLDs) incorporating RF design, capacity planning, AP placement, and cognitive tuning mechanisms; Zero Trust and WIPS security configurations integrated with cloud orchestration; Flexible data path options and scalable control‑plane architectures inherent to CloudVision’s cognitive approach.
  • Deployment Leadership & Technical Execution: Lead and direct wireless deployment efforts in customer environments and ensure alignment to Arista cognitive design principles. Mentor and guide junior engineers through zero‑touch provisioning and onboarding of Arista AP platforms via CV‑CUE; Implementation of AI/ML‑enabled analytics and automated remediation features; Integration of AP connectivity with hosted identity management and external NAC solutions. Validate configurations and deployments to ensure stable, optimized performance across cognitive AP platforms and centralized CloudVision management.
  • Pre‑Sales Scoping & Technical Support: Participate in pre‑sales scoping calls with sales and delivery leadership. Provide detailed input on the effort required to transition customers from legacy Wi‑Fi environments to Arista, Cisco, Aruba and other OEM's or managed architectures; Level of Effort (LOE) estimation for discovery, design, deployment, optimization, and cutover phases; Validate technical assumptions for proposals and SOWs based on real experience with Arista cloud‑native wireless technologies.
  • Escalation & Customer Assurance: Serve as the escalation point for delivery issues related to Wi‑Fi behavior under load and real‑world spectrum conditions; Automation orchestration failures or troubleshooting of AI/ML‑driven recommendations; Cross‑domain issues spanning wired/wireless convergence and identity enforcement. Engage directly in customer escalation calls to remediate issues, restore confidence, and guide recovery.

Required Technical Expertise (Priority Order)

  • Arista Wireless – REQUIRED / NON-NEGOTIABLE: Hands‑on design, deployment, and operational experience with Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi access point platforms (Wi‑Fi 6/6E/7) and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV‑CUE) centralized management and cognitive analytics, AI/ML‑driven automation, telemetry, and troubleshooting inherent to Arista cognitive networking.
  • HPE Aruba Wireless Enterprise: Wireless design and deployment experience.
  • Juniper Wireless: Familiarity with Juniper Mist and related wireless platforms.
  • Cisco Wireless: Experience with Cisco enterprise wireless architectures.
  • Nile Wireless: Exposure to or hands‑on experience with Nile wireless solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Track record of enterprise wireless design and deployment, with at least the majority of experience on Arista cognitive wireless solutions.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead design and delivery teams and mentor engineers in real time.
  • Communication skills to interact confidently with technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to balance design, deployment, and escalation responsibilities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in IT professional services or consulting.
  • Multi‑vendor wireless migration expertise.
  • Wireless certifications, particularly with Arista technologies.
  • Experience developing technical scoping documentation, proposals, and LOE estimates.

Role Characteristics

  • Combination of technical leadership, hands‑on execution, pre‑sales engagement, and post‑deployment escalation support.
  • Acts as the architectural authority for Arista wireless engagements.
  • Expected to deliver high‑quality outcomes while transferring knowledge to delivery teams.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.

This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.

You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.

This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.

About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.

Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today

You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.

Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken

Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English

Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact

If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.

Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved

We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.

How to Apply

Apply via .

Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience

Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

Job description

Vaga para o time de Baterias.

Buscamos pessoas que assim como a gente, sejam inovadoras, práticas, objetivas, tenham paixão pelo que fazem e visem a excelência. Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

Main responsibilities

  • Elaborar, implementareacompanharprojetos, procedimentos normas de Segurança do Trabalho com foco especial em Prevenção e Proteção Contra Incêndios, analisando instalações, layouts industriais, materiais, processos produtivos, riscos operacionais, visando à mitigação de acidentes, incêndios e emergências;
  • Inspecionar estabelecimentos industriais, boas áreas administrativas, avaliando riscos de incêndio, explosão, atmosferas perigosas ou outros eventos críticos, propondomia de medidas preventivas e corretivas conforme legislação vigente ou boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Atuar na elaboração, análise e avaliação de projetos de prevenção e combate a incêndio, incluindo sistemas de detecção, alarme, hidrantes, sprinklers, iluminação e sinalização de emergência, rotas de fuga e compartimentação, acompanhando sua implantação e testes operacionais;
  • Interagir tecnicamente como Corpo de Bombeiros, órgãos licenciadores e demais entidades reguladoras, acompanhando processos de aprovação, vistorias, emissão e renovação de AVCB/ACPe e demais licenças relacionadas à segurança contra incêndio;
  • Indicar, especificar, validar equipamentos de segurança coletiva e individual, com ênfase em proteção contra incêndio e emergência (EPCs, EPIs, sistemas fixos e móveis de combate a incêndio);
  • Planejar, coordenar e executar simulados de emergência, incluindo cenários de incêndio, explosão, vazamento de produtos perigosos ou abandono de área, avaliando tempos de resposta, rotas de fuga, ação da brigada de incêndio e eficácia dos sistemas de proteção, bem como elaborando relatórios críticos e planos de melhoria;
  • Planejar e executar campanhas educativas, treinamentos e simulações de emergência, incluindo brigada de incêndio, abandono de área, resposta a vazamentos, incêndios e explosões, organizando palestras, workshops e exercícios simulados;
  • Analisar ocupação e atividades desenvolvidas nos ambientes de trabalho, avaliando riscos de periculosidade, insalubridade e riscos críticos relacionados ao incêndio e pânico, conforme legislação correspondente;
  • Monitorar, controlar e assegurar a conformidade de laudos, programas e documentos de SST, análises de risco e estudos de cenários de emergência;
  • Responder pela gestão de produtos químicos e inflamáveis, supervisionando avaliações de agentes químicos, classificação de áreas, armazenagem segura, compatibilidade química e controle de riscos de incêndio e explosões nos processos produtivos;
  • Elaborar, revisar e gerenciar documentos técnicos e legais para atendimento à legislação vigente, normas técnicas e padrões corporativos, realizando inspeções, auditorias, acompanhando emissão de relatórios, pareceres técnicos e planos de ação, bem como mantendo periodicamente os sistemas de proteção contra incêndio.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior completo em Engenharia, com pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho;

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes industriais e obras, preferencialmente em plantas de médio e grande porte;
  • Conhecimento sólido das Normas Regulamentadoras;
  • Domínio de normas técnicas aplicáveis à proteção contra incêndio, como ABNT (NBR9077, NBR16820, NBR13714, NBR10897, NBR17240), além de regulamentos do Corpo de Bombeiros;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de SST, especialmente ISO45001, e integração com requisitos ambientais e operacionais;
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação técnica, leitura e elaboração de documentos;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Camaçari–BA.

Additional information

  • Convênio médico e odontológico coparticipativo para você e seus dependentes;

Para essa cadeira, buscamos um perfil de Engenharia de Software (Backend) com especialização em IA Generativa. Não procuramos apenas quem “consome APIs”, mas quem constrói sistemas resilientes ao redor delas.

Sobre as Lojas Guaibim:

Com DNA 100% baiano , somos uma empresa nascida em Valença, interior da Bahia, especializada em Varejo de Eletrodomésticos, Eletrônicos, Telefonia Celular, Móveis, Ar Condicionado, Ventilação e Utilidades para o Lar.

Em 20 de março de 1982 iniciamos a nossa caminhada com a abertura da primeira loja em Valença . Depois de 14 anos abrimos mais uma loja em Ituberá, e foi em 2003 que de forma mais intensa, ampliamos nossa rede, a partir da nova loja de Gandú. De lá para cá crescemos ano a ano de forma consistente e sustentável.

Hoje já passamos de 60 canais de venda , entre o interior e a capital Salvador, em alguns bairros e nos principais Shoppings, além das vendas online através de site próprio e marketplaces, entregando para todo o Brasil , com uma frota própria de 25 caminhões, parceria com grandes transportadoras e o Centro de Distribuição que é um dos mais modernos da Bahia com mais de 30 mil metros quadrados.
